name: High-Capacity New Chinese Ceramic Pitcher
marketing_tip: A bold statement piece that combines grand capacity with refined New Chinese aesthetic.
body: This large-capacity pitcher is perfect for serving cold brew or hot tea to a large group with ease. Its elegant handle and heat-resistant ceramic body make it a practical yet stylish addition to any hospitality setting.
